title: A Sci-Fi Cover with Classic Vibes
content: Here's a cover painting forThe Pandora Stone,a science fiction paperback novel by William Greenleaf about the search for a powerful amber crystal of alien origin.I spotlit the bottom edge of the power cone and let the top half fall into the shadow. That way, the glowing orb could read as light over dark. I also introduced the blue and gold smoke on the sides of the cone, and carried the blue and gold theme throughout the picture.
